body:
Source correction pushed: `996c08bcb6d05843a26b9260d72da272aa4bc0d4` (normal push; no amend/force).

- P2 stale retained results: VerifyHomarr requires an enabled configured monitor and bounds the latest result age against h.Now() and its actual interval; future/expired results return a retry and Setup polls. Omitted/zero intervals use upstream’s one-minute default.
- P2 name-only destination: existing ConfigValue reads only the Project App config contract. The unique local/gatus-self monitor must be enabled and target GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/health exactly. No monitor creation, config rewrite, name-only adoption or external probe.
- P2 cached forced refresh: read widget.stats.snapshot before refresh; require the successful refreshed snapshot timestamp to advance. A lock/queue no-op remains an actionable wait, not one-hour cached acceptance.

Only App/target files, the existing Gatus fixture, and lane docs changed. No new test cases/files, dependencies, shared registry/functions or runtime actions. Focused existing tests, full Go build/vet/test gate, e2e-tag vet (not runtime), TUI/Activity/Gatus/Homarr race checks, shell syntax, gofmt and diff-check passed. Existing fixture clock/config aligned; no dedicated live regression proof claimed.

Please re-run both independent source axes against this pinned head. Runtime, common version/shape normalization, registration/ownership freeze and shared Stats binding lifecycle acceptance remain parent holds. Draft remains unmerged.

Owned-record provenance correction pushed at `c3aca1a6d3a8cff2d5d39ca96913960e9ce4b2c8` (normal conventional commit/push; clean worktree).

VerifyHomarr now calls `/api/v1/endpoints/local_gatus-self/statuses`. Gatus v5.37.0 routes this to EndpointStatus, which reads only store.Get().GetEndpointStatus; unlike the aggregate EndpointStatuses handler it does not append remote-instance records. The key is derived from the already validated unique enabled GET starter configuration: official ConvertGroupAndNameToKey joins sanitized group/name with an underscore, and the exact permitted local/gatus-self values are unchanged by sanitization. Returned key/name/group must corroborate it. Local 404 or empty results remain actionable waits; a fresh same-key remote success cannot substitute for the missing local result.

The exact destination, enabled/uniqueness guard and h.Now()/configured-interval freshness checks remain. Homarr native aggregate Stats count semantics and the before/after forced-refresh timestamp advancement fix are untouched. Only the Gatus App, existing own fixture route/object shapes and lane documentation changed; no new cases/files/comments/dependencies or shared edits.

Focused existing Gatus/Homarr tests, full Go build/vet/test, e2e-tag vet only, TUI/Activity/Gatus/Homarr race checks, gofmt, shell syntax and diff-check passed. These are source/fake-transport checks, not dedicated remote/runtime proof.

Please run fresh independent Standards and Spec reviews against this exact head. The cancelled reference custodian was not restarted; the committed baseline is unchanged. All native/normalized registration, rendering, shared-binding and lifecycle holds remain. No Docker/browser/provider/protected-file access, child agents or merge; PR remains draft.

Both independent fresh SOURCE-stage review axes pass with zero findings at c3aca1a6d3a8cff2d5d39ca96913960e9ce4b2c8 (fixed base 573a206e2b4a76574fd7e8cbd1f21c5a4c2fd37d). Spec independently verified the local-store-only route prevents remote aggregate records from impersonating the owned self-check; configured destination/enabled/uniqueness, interval/future freshness, missing/malformed rejection and true Stats timestamp advancement remain intact. Standards found no hard-standard violation or material smell. Read-only source re-reviews, not live proof. Keep draft: final shared-contract normalization/registration, real native rendering, genuinely multi-binding shared Stats and full lifecycle acceptance remain pending; #280 is not complete.

Both independent FINAL-NORMALIZED SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at b8ab54070762845e7720e7c16322a6611dc82eaa against frozen 6b82c55fb890c11a1388bd4e5a2f10b632ff4f7c. Registry reachability, owned local-store/configuration provenance, fresh native count equality and frozen helper reuse were independently checked; reported full local gate remains attributed to this head. This supersedes the unregistered leaf verdict, not runtime acceptance. Keep draft: actual native/rendered data, both installation orders, readiness recovery, shared cross-kind useful-survivor preservation and full lifecycle proof remain held. A bounded three-container driver is being prepared source-only; no runtime launched or approval implied by this comment.

The explicitly authorized R4 admission aborted before the supervisor launched: unix:///var/run/docker.sock resolved once to a missing local socket target. No canonical daemon endpoint was admitted; zero Docker commands, registry requests, image pulls, browser calls or proof resources were created. No retry or alternate context/endpoint was selected. Candidate b8ab54070762845e7720e7c16322a6611dc82eaa and all 41 reviewed static artifacts remain unchanged; abort evidence SHA-256 is 457be196147377697a7161a0310ff5408ba1013c7105e63425ed4e3bbc67bd52. No cleanup was necessary, and no Docker empty-resource readback is claimed. Both installation orders, image provenance, native/rendered data and lifecycle controls remain unobserved; #280 remains open and the PR stays draft. Restore the intended socket or supply another explicitly intended local UNIX endpoint, then obtain renewed one-attempt authorization before any runtime admission.
